notes.zh-CN: 会话滚到最底部时，左侧导航条不再停在倒数第二条。以前它只把顶到屏幕上方的消息算作当前项，最新一条消息停在下方就被漏掉；现在只要滚动条到底，高亮就落到最新一条消息上。内容不足一屏的会话不受影响。本次只发布 macOS 版，Windows 安装包因构建环境受限暂缺。
notes.en: The conversation rail no longer stops one message short of the end when you scroll to the bottom. It only counted a message that had reached the top of the viewport, so the newest one, still sitting lower on screen, was skipped; reaching the bottom of the thread now marks the newest message. Short threads that fit on one screen are unchanged. This release ships macOS only; Windows installers are missing because the build environment is blocked.
